title: Typeface Overview
slide_intent: Compare the same character repertoire across styles so designers can see how personality changes while reading remains consistent.
strategic_value: Showing related alphabets can help Burger King teams maintain a family resemblance across communication roles.
demonstration: Three rows show uppercase, lowercase, numerals and punctuation in Flame Bold, Regular and Sans on red.
practical_value: Inspect the available glyph forms before choosing a style for a particular text role.

content_islands.spec: Align three labeled role rows with matching character sequences across the right area.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text links the three styles to a flexible voice and consistent impression.
reference_purposes.Expression: The complete specimen rows expose differences between Bold, Regular and Sans.
reference_purposes.Application: The specimens retain headline, subhead and body-role labels.
